cut: 3D v1 stills (22 Nov, en only). Owner, 22 Nov: 'How about prepping in the US?' / 'Maybe show bunker footage. A bit like fallout vibe'. See plan/films/52-be-prepared.md.
argument: After a nationwide flight ground stop and bank and email outages, Americans are buying generators and bunkers, while the Vice President says no crisis is coming but to be prepared for everything.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word

captions.source: 13 Nov 2026: a nationwide FAA ground stop of more than four hours; the FAA called it a technical problem (communication failures at several air route traffic control centers); DHS said it did not appear to be a cyberattack (CNBC, FAA Q&A, Axios, 13 Nov). Search summaries, 22 Nov.
Outages at Microsoft (Outlook) and at banks including JPMorgan Chase followed (Fortune 18 Nov; NewsNation; Yahoo). Search summaries, 22 Nov.

text.en: A bunker seller: / one sold in 2018. / Now [one a day].

captions.source: Atlas Survival Shelters' owner, as reported by TribLive (Nov 2026): one bomb shelter sold in 2018, now one a day in most cases; prices from about $20,000 to millions. The seller's own claim, attributed in the tag.
Fortune, 19 Nov 2026: 'Now Costco is selling out of generators'; big-box runs on water, generators and power banks (NewsNation, Fox LA, Axios 19 Nov).

text.en: The Vice / President: no / crisis is coming. / But be [prepared].

captions.source: JD Vance to Laura Ingraham, Fox News (aired 16/17 Nov 2026): 'We do not see a crisis coming down, but you have to be prepared for everything' (Yahoo/Fox; Fortune renders 'We don't see'). The caption PARAPHRASES (no quotation marks); the exact full sentence is in tag5 and on the TV.

post.en: 13 Nov: every US flight grounded. Then email and banks went down. A bunker seller says he sold one in 2018 and now sells one a day; generators are selling out. The Vice President: "We do not see a crisis coming down, but you have to be prepared for everything."
